newsitem.title: USA: Boykin buys two Florida hotels for $13.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Boykin buys two Florida hotels for $13.5 mln.

text.p: Boykin Lodging Co said Friday it has acquired two full-service hotels in Florida for $13.5 million.
The hotels are the 118-room Hilton Melbourne Beach in Melbourne and the 205-room Whitehall Hotel in Daytona Beach.

Funds for the purchase, said the company, came from the $190 million raised in its initial public offering. Both properties will be leased to Boykin Management Co, a company affiliate, which will manage the properties.
These acquisitions increase the number of hotels Boykin Lodging owns from nine to eleven, and increase total guest rooms to 2,731, from 2,408.
Boykin Lodging Company is a Cleveland-based real estate investment trust (REIT) which focuses on the ownership of full service, premium branded resort and commercial hotels.
